newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products down sharply on soybean weakness.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products down sharply on soybean weakness.

text.p: CBOT soymeal and soyoil futures were sharply lower at midsession Monday, mostly under spillover pressure from soybeans, traders said.
"The meal is down mostly in line with the beans," one floor trader said.
Some of the weakness in soymeal was traced to reports that Taiwan might resell excess soymeal to China, traders said.
An outbreak of hoof and mouth disease in Taiwan's hog population has significantly reduced demand for soymeal, traders there said.
In early trading, Cargill sold 100 lots May soymeal.
Soyoil futures also posted heavy losses in early trade Monday in response to the weakness in soybean futures, traders said.
At 1102 CST, soyoil was down 0.28 to 0.45 cent per pound with May down 0.45 at 23.95. Soymeal futures were down $3.00 to $5.00, with May down $3.60 at $273.80.
